title: Washington Trust voted Best Bank in The Westerly Sun’s 2026 Reader’s…
summary: We take pride in helping our banking customers reach their financial goals and serving our local communities
body_markdown:
**WESTERLY, R.I.** – The Washington Trust Company ([Washington Trust](https://www.washtrust.com/) ) has been voted Best Bank in The Westerly Sun’s 2026 Reader’s Choice Awards, earning first place among four nominees in the Bank category.


“We are honored to receive this recognition and grateful to everyone who voted for Washington Trust,” **said Washington Trust Chairman and CEO Ned Handy** . “For more than 226 years, we have been committed to helping our customers, businesses and communities succeed, and we thank them for the trust they place in us every day.”


The Westerly Sun's annual Reader's Choice Awards recognize community members’ favorite local businesses. Voting is open to the public and winners are determined by the top votes in each category.


Washington Trust currently operates 28 branches throughout Rhode Island and Connecticut, and will open new branches in Pawtucket in December 2026 and Bristol in early 2027. The Bank offers a full range of products and solutions for individuals, families and businesses throughout the region, including retail banking, mortgage and home equity lending, commercial banking, and wealth management and trust services.
